description: This file is a shell script used in an OpenWrt-based system to control status LEDs during system boot and recovery processes. It sources external functions from leds.sh and defines functions to set LED states based on different system states such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, and normal operation.

methods.name: set_led_state
methods.description: Sets the system LED state based on the provided system status argument.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Calls set_led_state if any of the LED trigger variables are set, to update the LED state accordingly.
